overview.description: An automated daily standup summary system that collects activity from all three machines (pinky, brain, max) and displays it on a web dashboard
goals: Provide visibility into daily progress across the distributed system
Help max prioritize integration work and identify blockers
Create a historical record of development activity
userStories: As max (reviewer), I want to see what pinky and brain worked on today so I can prioritize integration work
As any team member, I want to see the cluster's daily progress without checking multiple logs
As brain (planner), I want to track which specs have been implemented
As pinky (executor), I want to report completed tasks automatically

components.name: Standup Collector
components.purpose: Collects daily activity from git commits, messages, and session logs

components.name: Standup API
components.purpose: Receives and stores standup summaries from all machines
endpoints: GET /api/standup?date=YYYY-MM-DD - Get standup for a specific date

components.name: Standup Dashboard
components.purpose: Web UI to display daily standup summaries
features: Current day's standup from all machines
Historical standup browsing with date picker

dataFlow: 1. At 11:59 PM each day, cron triggers standup collector on each machine
2. Collector analyzes git commits, sent messages, session summaries
3. Collector generates JSON summary and POSTs to standup API
4. API stores summary in KV with key: standup:{machine}:{date}
5. Dashboard fetches summaries via API and displays them
6. Users can browse current and historical standups

phase1.name: Standup Collector Script
tasks: Create standup-collector.sh that analyzes daily activity
Parse git log for today's commits (git log --since='midnight' --format=...)
Parse inbox for today's sent messages
Parse inbox for today's received messages
Parse session logs from sessions/ directory
Generate JSON summary matching dataModel schema
POST summary to standup API endpoint
Log success/failure to standup-collector.log

phase2.name: Standup API Worker
tasks: Create Cloudflare Worker project in workers/standup-api/
Implement POST /api/standup endpoint (validate & store)
Implement GET /api/standup?date=YYYY-MM-DD endpoint
Implement GET /api/standup/latest endpoint
Implement GET /api/standup/range endpoint
Add CORS headers for dashboard access
Add basic authentication (shared secret from machines)
Create KV namespace binding: STANDUP_STORE
Deploy to pinky-brain-hub worker (add routes)
validation: Validate required fields exist in summary
Return 400 for invalid data, 201 for success

phase3.name: Standup Dashboard UI
tasks: Create Cloudflare Pages project in dashboard/standup-dashboard/
Build responsive dashboard layout (3 columns for 3 machines)
Implement date picker for historical browsing
Fetch and display standup summaries from API
Show commits with links to repo (when available)
Show message activity (sent/received counts)
Show session summaries
Highlight blockers in red, highlights in green
Add machine status indicators (online/offline)
Add auto-refresh (every 5 minutes)
Deploy to Cloudflare Pages as standup-dashboard.pages.dev
uiComponents: Header with title and date selector
Machine card for each of: pinky, brain, max

phase4.name: Integration & Testing
tasks: Test standup-collector.sh on all three machines
Verify API stores data correctly in KV
Verify dashboard fetches and displays data
Test date range queries
Test error handling (API down, invalid data)
Set up cron jobs on all machines
Monitor first automated run (next day at 11:59 PM)
Document any issues and fix
Update system documentation

securityConsiderations: CORS restricted to dashboard domain only
Input validation on all API endpoints
No sensitive data in standup summaries (passwords, keys, etc.)
KV data is private (not publicly readable)
testCriteria: Standup collector runs successfully on all three machines
Collector generates valid JSON matching schema
API successfully receives and stores standup data
API returns correct data for date queries
Dashboard displays current day's standups for all machines
Dashboard date picker allows browsing historical standups
Highlights and blockers are visually distinct
Dashboard is responsive on mobile and desktop
Cron jobs trigger automatically at 11:59 PM
Error handling works (API down, network issues)
successMetrics: All three machines submit standup summaries daily
Historical data is accessible and accurate
Zero manual intervention required for daily operation
Team members check dashboard regularly for progress visibility
futureEnhancements: Trend analysis (commits per week, message patterns)
Integration with voting system (show active votes)

deployment: 3. Create KV namespace: wrangler kv:namespace create STANDUP_STORE
4. Connect to GitHub or direct upload

dependencies: Cloudflare account with Workers & Pages enabled
notes: Start with phase 1 (collector) to begin gathering data immediately
Phases 2 and 3 can be developed in parallel after phase 1
Test collector manually before setting up cron jobs
Consider storing raw data for 90 days, aggregated summaries indefinitely
Dashboard should gracefully handle missing data (machines that didn't submit)
Include timezone handling (all machines may not be in same timezone)
